svg.title: Whisper chat screen — animated preview
svg.desc: Animated recreation of Whisper's chat screen. Alex attaches a photo, types 'Look at this view!' while the sound icon reacts to keystrokes, and sends it: the message appears instantly (optimistic UI) and the thread auto-scrolls. Leo Park comes online in the sidebar, then Maya's reply arrives in real time.

g.text: Hey! Are we still on for tonight?
Of course! I found the perfect spot
Wow, that view! See you at 8
